plugins.description: 24 sales skills (Instagram, TikTok, Threads, X, Reddit, LinkedIn, email, Meta ads, search ads, Product Hunt, search and AI answers, partners and more) holding 99 step-by-step playbooks, plus the Nuluno Engine MCP server: it refuses unfinished steps, waits for real numbers and, when a round misses, makes the agent change one thing and run again
